extras.desc: sustained pitched pad / hum in the vocal stem before verse 1 (no lyric)
tag after 'I can wait.': the hard hit (197.43) starts ~7 s of full band with a 'dun-dun-dun' vocal chant; drums out at ~204.6, the chant alone until ~209

notes: Timeline = the WAV master (see `source`); the Demucs stems are separated from it, so no offset. Lines: data/lines.txt, derived from the sheet input/force-push.txt by lyrics_sheet.py, with the two places the vocal differs from the sheet replaced by what is sung (tuning.py SUNG: pre-chorus 1 sings the stage direction, 'Stop, one beat and you're gone'; pre-chorus 2 sings 'No more reading your logs, and now you want a revert?'). Method: (1) CTC emissions (20 ms) of the vocal stem from torchaudio MMS_FA and wav2vec2-large-lv60k-960h on the mono sum and the left/right channels, fused as a probability mixture; (2) one global constrained Viterbi alignment of all 64 lines with a garbage 'star' token between lines; (3) signal refinement of word starts/ends on the vocal stem (rest onsets, spectral-flux onsets, frication); (4) cross-check against faster-whisper large-v3-turbo (CPU) and the individual models/channels; (5) the disagreements inspected on zoomed spectrogram/pitch/onset plots against the tracked beat grid, with one anchor and 14 manual starts (FIX), mostly in the gang-chant post-choruses. conf: 0.35 + agreement of the alternatives (<=60 ms) + CTC posterior + Whisper agreement; manual fixes carry their own conf. Least certain: the gang chants' '(hey!)' and 'Like you've never' (+-100 ms, shouted over each other), 'I' in 'Keep your local copy, I don't care' (69.9 or ~70.4), chorus 'I rewrote' (56.4-56.7). Elsewhere word starts are expected within ~30-50 ms.
